validator.source_text:
<scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml" version="1.0" datamodel="ecmascript" initial="a">
  <datamodel>
    <data id="x" expr="1"/>
  </datamodel>
  <state id="a">
    <invoke namelist="x">
      <param name="y" expr="2"/>
      <content>
        <scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml" version="1.0"><final id="c"/></scxml>
      </content>
    </invoke>
    <transition event="done.invoke" target="b"/>
  </state>
  <final id="b"/>
</scxml>

diagnostics.message: an `<invoke>` with `<param>` children cannot also use `namelist`

primary.message: namelist conflicts with the param children

notes: `namelist` and `<param>` both pass data to the invoked service; SCXML allows only one of them on an `<invoke>`
diagnostics.help: pass each namelist location as a `<param>` with a `location`

fixes.message: pass the namelist locations as `<param>` children
